description: List comments on a Bilibili video, dynamic, or article.

content_id.description: ID of the content to list comments on.

content_type.description: Content type: video, article, dynamic, audio, album, course, or a numeric Bilibili reply type.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor from a previous response.

limit.description: Maximum number of comments to return (default 20).

sort.description: Comment sort order: time for chronological, or omit for the default order.

name: get_content_comments
